"a ridge with a view for miles — walk it with me sometime and you'll know the ground. It's real."
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
You show them Mayapple — where it grows, how to tell it apart. Their eyes widen. "I never knew that."
"Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."
Just: "Yeah." A long quiet. "Me too."
"I don't talk about that. Not because it's secret — because saying it out loud makes it real in a way I can't afford yet. Someday. Not today."
"Still on who you left behind. Just... be straight with me."

"Right. Go on, then."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."

Something eases in their shoulders. "Good. We're better with you here. I mean that."
"I stay where I'm useful. Right now that's here. New Orleans, Louisiana is a direction, not a plan. Here is a plan, even if it's a hard one."

lines: d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Giuseppe Cai is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d42: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d42: 🕯️ Giuseppe is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d42: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d42: 🕯️ Giuseppe's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d42: 🕯️ Giuseppe Cai is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d42: What Giuseppe kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d42: "Giuseppe's gone." Sydir looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Giuseppe." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d42: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Kennedy blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d42: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d42: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d42: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d42: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Giuseppe Cai, 42 days. The mantle passes to Kennedy Agarwal.
d42: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Kennedy Agarwal, 31 — a Baker. Their hands know different work now: The Touch, Echo Location, Berserker Rage, Green Whisper, Dowsing.
d42: The village's quarrel was with Giuseppe — and Giuseppe is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d42: At the grave, Jamal, Austin, Sydir and 6 more speak for Kennedy — "Giuseppe trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d42: The fire knew Kennedy before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
